text: Welcome back everyone. Today we are reviewing the quarterly numbers. Revenue landed four percent above the forecast we set in April. And support costs stayed flat even with the new customers onboarded. That is better than I expected. What drove the revenue beat? Mostly the enterprise renewals. Two accounts expanded their seats early. The onboarding automation helped there. Setup time dropped by half. Let's put both of those in the board summary as highlights. I can draft the revenue section by Monday. And I will add the support metrics with the charts from the dashboard. Thank you both. We will review the draft together next week.
